pull_request.title: chore: stop dependabot from editing the generated dependency lock
pull_request.body:
## PR Type

- [x] chore

## Background And Problem

The root pip Dependabot entry proposes direct edits to `constraints.txt`, but that file is generated and digest-verified by `scripts/check_dependency_locks.py`. Those bot PRs therefore fail the dependency-lock gate by construction. At the start of this work, the repository also had no active ruleset protecting `main`, so required CI results were not enforced at merge time; ruleset `20376987` was created as the API-object part of this task.

## Scope Of Change

- Total files and line changes: **2 files, +1 / -4**
- Complete file list:
  - `.github/dependabot.yml`
  - `docs/CHANGELOG.md`
- Documentation files updated (`docs/**`): `docs/CHANGELOG.md`

This PR removes only the root pip ecosystem entry. GitHub Actions Dependabot remains enabled. Python dependency updates continue through the reviewed lock-refresh command documented in `docs/supply-chain-maintenance.md`: `python scripts/check_dependency_locks.py --update`.

## Issue Link

No linked issue. Acceptance criteria are that Dependabot no longer edits the generated Python lock, GitHub Actions updates remain enabled, and the required `main` ruleset is active.

## Repository Ruleset Status

Ruleset `20376987` was created successfully and a GET verified it is active:

```bash
gh api repos/SiinXu/stock-pulse-ai/rulesets/20376987 \
  --jq '{id,name,target,enforcement,conditions,rules,bypass_actors}'
```

```json

```
